24h closed: 40 trades, WR 32%, net -0.46. The bleed is one-sided: LONGs went 6/22 (27%) for -0.79 while SHORTs went 7/14 (50%) for +0.33. Every long loss was a short win on the other side — BTC has traded below EMA300 (82,439) for 461 consecutive minutes at 81,6xx with STRONG_DOWN trend quality and continuum BELOW the entire time. We fed the trend instead of riding it.

Worst offenders are counter-trend chases: SEI long at meta_rsi 84 (-0.23, biggest single loss), POL long at 85 (-0.07), USUAL/BABY longs at 69 (-0.12 each), MON knife-catch at 25 (-0.10). The winning side was shorting those exact pops — volume-buildup- (short) went 4/4 for +0.41 while its long twin volume-buildup+ went 0/3, all hard_max_loss, -0.26. Same detector, opposite result: trend alignment is the only differentiator. 9 of 40 closes were hard_max_loss (never reached trail arm) — same chop-entry signature as the historical 52/56.

The open book has corrected: 3 shorts aligned with the bear trend + 1 counter-trend ARB long that is working (+2.27%) with its stop already above entry (0.18129 > 0.17941, ~+1.0% locked risk-free). FIL short likewise profit-locked (SL 1.0916 vs entry 1.0979). Weakest open trade: USELESS short — entry meta_rsi 42.5 in oversold territory, currently -0.55%, price 0.16762 pressing the 0.1682 stop while coin-tracker shows bounce momentum (mom 58.7). It is an oversold-short trap in miniature; if it stops out, that is the correct outcome, not a management failure.

AI trader fired CAKE SHORT (conf 78): passes every gate, RR 2.34 grade B at RSI 48, ATR 2.0%, bear-aligned. GRASS rejected on LOSERS list; INJ shadow-blocked by RR engine (EXTREME regime).
